# heist_credential (Data Source)

Safe metadata and application links of a credential. Secrets are never returned.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "heist_credential" "admin" {
  id = "3f6c2a1b-7d4e-4c8a-9b0f-1e2d3c4b5a69"
}

output "admin_applications" {
  value = [for app in data.heist_credential.admin.applications : app.url]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Credential ID.

### Read-Only

- `accepted_invite` (Boolean) Whether the account has accepted its invitation.
- `applications` (Attributes List) Applications the credential is linked to. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--applications))
- `hint` (Attributes) Safe metadata about the sign-in details. Fields not used by the type are null. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--hint))
- `instructions` (String) Sign-in instructions.
- `login_url` (String) URL of the login page.
- `type` (String) Sign-in method.

<a id="nestedatt--applications"></a>
### Nested Schema for `applications`

Read-Only:

- `entity_id` (String) Tenant the credential belongs to in the application.
- `id` (String) Application ID.
- `is_primary` (Boolean) Whether this is the primary credential of its tenant.
- `role_level` (Number) Privilege level of the credential in the application.
- `url` (String) Application URL.


<a id="nestedatt--hint"></a>
### Nested Schema for `hint`

Read-Only:

- `client_id` (String) OAuth client ID.
- `cookie_name` (String) Static cookie name.
- `email` (String) Email address.
- `has_mfa` (Boolean) Whether sign-in uses multi-factor authentication.
- `header_name` (String) Header the key or token is sent in.
- `masked_key` (String) API key with most characters masked.
- `otp_length` (Number) Length of the one-time password.
- `password_length` (Number) Length of the password.
- `phone` (String) Phone number.
- `phone_prefix` (String) Phone number prefix.
- `scope` (String) OAuth scope.
- `secret_names` (List of String) Names of CUSTOM secrets.
- `token_url` (String) OAuth token endpoint URL.
- `username` (String) Username.
